title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of Justice on Issuing the Opinions on Punishing Illegal and Criminal Acts that Hinder the Prevention and Control of the COVID-19 Outbreak in Accordance with the Law
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of Justice

Notice on Issuing the "Opinions on Legally Punishing Crimes and Illegal Acts Hindering the Prevention and Control of the COVID-19 Epidemic"

Fa Fa [2020] No. 7

To the High People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, Public Security Departments (Bureaus), and Justice Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Courts and Military Procuratorates of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, the People's Procuratorate of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, the Public Security Bureau, and the Justice Bureau:

To implement the "Opinions of the Central Committee for the Comprehensive Rule of Law on Legally Preventing and Controlling the COVID-19 Epidemic and Effectively Protecting the People's Life, Health, and Safety" examined and approved at the third meeting of the Central Committee for the Comprehensive Rule of Law on February 5, 2020, the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of Justice have jointly formulated the "Opinions on Legally Punishing Crimes and Illegal Acts Hindering the Prevention and Control of the COVID-19 Epidemic." It is hereby issued for your earnest implementation in light of actual circumstances. New situations and issues encountered during implementation shall be promptly reported to the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of Justice respectively.

February 6, 2020

Opinions on Legally Punishing Crimes and Illegal Acts Hindering the Prevention and Control of the COVID-19 Epidemic

To legally punish crimes and illegal acts hindering the prevention and control of the COVID-19 epidemic, protect the life, health, and safety of the people, ensure social order and stability, and ensure the smooth progress of epidemic prevention and control work, these Opinions are formulated in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws and judicial interpretations.

1. Raise Political Stance and Fully Recognize the Great Significance of Maintaining Overall Social Stability During the Epidemic Prevention and Control Period

People's courts, people's procuratorates, public security organs, and judicial administrative organs at all levels shall effectively unify their thoughts and actions with the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's series of important instructions on the prevention and control of the COVID-19 epidemic. They shall resolutely implement the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the work arrangements of the Central Leading Group for the Response to the COVID-19 Epidemic. In accordance with the requirements of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, they shall strengthen "four consciousnesses," strengthen "four confidences," and achieve "two safeguards." They shall always place the life, health, and safety of the people first, resolutely regard epidemic prevention and control as the overriding top priority, fully utilize legal provisions, and legally, promptly, and severely punish all types of crimes and illegal acts hindering epidemic prevention and control, providing a strong legal guarantee for resolutely winning the battle against the epidemic.

2. Accurately Apply the Law and Legally Severely Punish All Types of Crimes and Illegal Acts Hindering Epidemic Prevention and Control

(1) Legally severely punish crimes of resisting epidemic prevention and control measures. Deliberately spreading the pathogen of COVID-19 under any of the following circumstances, endangering public security, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of endangering public security by dangerous means in accordance with Article 114 and paragraph 1 of Article 115 of the Criminal Law:

1. Persons already diagnosed as COVID-19 patients or pathogen carriers, who refuse isolation treatment or leave isolation treatment without authorization before the expiration of the isolation period and enter public places or take public transportation;

2. Persons suspected of having COVID-19 who refuse isolation treatment or leave isolation treatment without authorization before the expiration of the isolation period and enter public places or take public transportation, resulting in the spread of COVID-19.

Others who refuse to implement the prevention and control measures proposed by health and epidemic prevention agencies in accordance with the Law on the Prevention and Treatment of Infectious Diseases, causing the spread of COVID-19 or creating a serious risk of spread, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of hindering the prevention and treatment of infectious diseases in accordance with Article 330 of the Criminal Law.

Obstructing state organ staff (including persons performing public duties in organizations exercising the state's administrative powers for epidemic prevention and control in accordance with laws and regulations, persons performing public duties in organizations authorized by state organs to exercise epidemic prevention and control powers on behalf of state organs, and persons not included in the staffing of state organs but performing public duties related to epidemic prevention and control in state organs) from legally exercising epidemic prevention, quarantine, compulsory isolation, isolation treatment, and other measures by means of violence or threat shall be convicted and punished as the crime of obstructing public service in accordance with paragraph 1 and paragraph 3 of Article 277 of the Criminal Law. Violently attacking a people's police officer who is lawfully performing duties shall be convicted as the crime of obstructing public service and given a heavier punishment.

(2) Legally severely punish crimes of violent injury to medical personnel. During the epidemic prevention and control period, intentionally injuring medical personnel causing minor injury or more serious consequences, or committing acts such as tearing off protective equipment or spitting on medical personnel, causing the medical personnel to be infected with COVID-19, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of intentional injury in accordance with Article 234 of the Criminal Law.

Beating medical personnel at will under vile circumstances shall be convicted and punished as the crime of picking quarrels and provoking trouble in accordance with Article 293 of the Criminal Law.

Publicly insulting or intimidating medical personnel by violence or other methods, meeting the provisions of Articles 246 and 293 of the Criminal Law, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of insult or the crime of picking quarrels and provoking trouble.

Unlawfully restricting medical personnel's personal freedom, such as by preventing them from leaving the workplace, meeting the provisions of Article 238 of the Criminal Law, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of false imprisonment.

(3) Legally severely punish crimes of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard goods. During the epidemic prevention and control period, producing or selling counterfeit or substandard preventive or protective products or materials, or producing or selling counterfeit or substandard drugs used for the prevention and treatment of COVID-19, meeting the provisions of Articles 140, 141, and 142 of the Criminal Law, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of producing and selling counterfeit or substandard products, the crime of producing and selling counterfeit drugs, or the crime of producing and selling substandard drugs.

During the epidemic prevention and control period, producing medical equipment such as masks, goggles, and protective clothing that do not meet national or industry standards for ensuring human health, or selling, while knowing them to be substandard, medical equipment sufficient to seriously endanger human health, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of producing and selling medical equipment that does not meet standards in accordance with Article 145 of the Criminal Law.

(4) Legally severely punish crimes of price gouging. During the epidemic prevention and control period, violating state regulations on market operations and price management, engaging in hoarding and profiteering, inflating the prices of urgently needed protective items such as masks, goggles, protective clothing, and disinfectants, or drugs, or other goods related to people's livelihoods, seeking huge profits, with a relatively large amount of illegal income or other serious circumstances, seriously disrupting market order, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of illegal business operation in accordance with item (4) of Article 225 of the Criminal Law.

(5) Legally severely punish crimes of fraud and mass seizure. During the epidemic prevention and control period, defrauding public or private property under the pretext of researching, producing, or selling items for epidemic prevention and control, or fabricating facts to defraud public donations of money or items, with a relatively large amount, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of fraud in accordance with Article 266 of the Criminal Law.

During the epidemic prevention and control period, violating state regulations, using advertising to make false propaganda about goods or services for sale under the pretext of epidemic prevention and control, causing many people to be deceived, with a relatively large amount of illegal income or other serious circumstances, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of false advertising in accordance with Article 222 of the Criminal Law.

During the epidemic prevention and control period, gathering a crowd to seize public or private property, especially epidemic prevention and control and support materials, with a relatively large amount or other serious circumstances, the principal offenders and active participants shall be convicted and punished as the crime of mass seizure in accordance with Article 268 of the Criminal Law.

(6) Legally severely punish crimes of spreading rumors and false information. Fabricating false epidemic information and spreading it on information networks or other media, or, knowing it to be false epidemic information, intentionally spreading it on information networks or other media, seriously disrupting social order, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of fabricating and intentionally spreading false information in accordance with paragraph 2 of Article 291-1 of the Criminal Law.

Fabricating false information, or, knowing it to be fabricated false information, spreading it on information networks, or organizing or instructing others to spread it on information networks, causing a disturbance and seriously disrupting public order, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of picking quarrels and provoking trouble in accordance with item (4) of paragraph 1 of Article 293 of the Criminal Law.

Using the COVID-19 epidemic to manufacture or spread rumors, inciting secession or undermining national unity, or inciting subversion of state power or overthrow of the socialist system, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of inciting secession or the crime of inciting subversion of state power in accordance with paragraph 2 of Article 103 and paragraph 2 of Article 105 of the Criminal Law.

An internet service provider who fails to perform the information network security management obligations stipulated by laws and administrative regulations, refuses to take corrective measures after being ordered by the regulatory authority, causing the widespread dissemination of false epidemic information or other illegal information, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of refusing to perform information network security management obligations in accordance with Article 286-1 of the Criminal Law.

Cases involving false epidemic information shall be handled legally, precisely, and appropriately. Those who maliciously fabricate false epidemic information to create social panic, provoke social emotions, disrupt public order, especially those who maliciously attack the Party and the government, taking the opportunity to incite subversion of state power or overthrow the socialist system, shall be severely punished according to law. Those who disseminate false information out of credulity without causing harm shall not be treated as a crime.

(7) Legally severely punish crimes of dereliction of duty, embezzlement, and misappropriation during epidemic prevention and control. State organ staff responsible for organization, coordination, command, disaster investigation, control, medical treatment, information transmission, transportation, material support, and other duties during epidemic prevention and control work who abuse their power or neglect their duties, causing significant losses to public property, state and people's interests, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of abuse of power or the crime of dereliction of duty in accordance with Article 397 of the Criminal Law.

Staff of health administrative departments who are seriously irresponsible, failing to perform or earnestly perform their prevention and control regulatory duties, causing the spread or epidemic of COVID-19 with serious circumstances, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of dereliction of duty in infectious disease prevention and control in accordance with Article 409 of the Criminal Law.

Persons engaged in experimentation, preservation, carriage, or transport of bacteria or virus strains of infectious diseases who violate the relevant regulations of the health administrative department of the State Council, causing the spread of the COVID-19 virus strain with serious consequences, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of spreading infectious disease virus strains in accordance with Article 331 of the Criminal Law.

State functionaries, persons entrusted with the management of state property, or persons of companies, enterprises, or other entities who, taking advantage of their positions, embezzle, intercept, or unlawfully possess by other means funds or materials used for the prevention and control of COVID-19, or misappropriate the aforementioned funds or materials for personal use, meeting the provisions of Articles 382, 383, 271, 384, and 272 of the Criminal Law, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of embezzlement, the crime of job-related embezzlement, the crime of misappropriation of public funds, or the crime of misappropriation of funds. Misappropriation of disaster relief, social welfare, or relief funds or materials used for the prevention and control of COVID-19, meeting the provisions of Article 273 of the Criminal Law, the directly responsible persons shall be convicted and punished as the crime of misappropriation of specific funds and materials.

(8) Legally severely punish crimes of destroying transportation facilities. During the epidemic prevention and control period, destroying tracks, bridges, tunnels, highways, airports, waterways, lighthouses, signs, or engaging in other destructive activities, sufficient to cause the overturning or destruction of trains, cars, trams, ships, or aircraft, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of destroying transportation facilities in accordance with Article 117 and paragraph 1 of Article 119 of the Criminal Law.

In handling cases of destroying transportation facilities, the specific circumstances shall be distinguished, and the case shall be handled carefully in accordance with law. For those who, to prevent the spread of the epidemic, block roads without authorization impeding traffic without causing serious consequences, they shall generally not be treated as a crime, and the matter shall be corrected by the competent authorities.

(9) Legally severely punish crimes of destroying wildlife resources. Illegally hunting or killing nationally protected precious or endangered wild animals, or illegally purchasing, transporting, or selling nationally protected precious or endangered wild animals or their products, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of illegally hunting and killing precious or endangered wild animals or the crime of illegally purchasing, transporting, and selling precious or endangered wild animals and their products in accordance with paragraph 1 of Article 341 of the Criminal Law.

Violating hunting regulations, hunting in no-hunting areas, during no-hunting periods, or using prohibited tools or methods, destroying wildlife resources with serious circumstances, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of illegal hunting in accordance with paragraph 2 of Article 341 of the Criminal Law.

Violating state regulations, illegally dealing in non-nationally protected wildlife and their products (including operating trading venues, conducting online sales, processing food for sale, etc.), disrupting market order with serious circumstances, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of illegal business operation in accordance with item (4) of Article 225 of the Criminal Law.

Anyone who knows or should know that the items are nationally protected precious or endangered wild animals or their products and illegally purchases them for consumption or other purposes, meeting the provisions of paragraph 1 of Article 341 of the Criminal Law, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of illegally purchasing precious or endangered wild animals and their products.

Anyone who knows or should know that the items are illegally hunted wild animals and still purchases them, meeting the provisions of Article 312 of the Criminal Law, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of concealing and concealing the proceeds of crime.

(10) Legally severely punish illegal acts hindering epidemic prevention and control. Acts committed under items (1) to (9) above that do not constitute a crime shall be subject to public security penalties by public security organs in accordance with the Public Security Administration Punishments Law, concerning fabricating facts to disrupt public order, disrupting unit order, disrupting public place order, picking quarrels and provoking trouble, refusing to execute decisions and orders under a state of emergency, obstructing the performance of duties, breaking through warning zones, assaulting others, intentional injury, insulting others, fraud, illegally digging pits or mining stones along railway lines, stealing or damaging road public facilities, damaging railway facilities and equipment, intentionally damaging property, seizing public or private property, etc., or shall be subject to other administrative penalties by relevant departments.

For crimes and illegal acts committed during the epidemic prevention and control period, it shall be considered as an aggravating factor, reflecting the policy requirement of severity in accordance with law, effectively deterring and punishing such crimes and illegal acts, maintaining legal authority, maintaining social order, and protecting the life, health, and safety of the people.

3. Improve and Perfect the Working Mechanism to Ensure Case Handling Effectiveness and Safety

(1) Timely investigation of cases. Public security organs shall, in accordance with law, promptly file and investigate cases hindering the prevention and control of the COVID-19 epidemic and comprehensively collect and fix evidence. For persons who refuse isolation treatment or leave isolation treatment without authorization before the expiration of the isolation period, the public security organs shall, in accordance with law, assist medical institutions and relevant departments in taking compulsory isolation treatment measures. Law enforcement shall be strict, standardized, fair, and civilized.

(2) Strengthen communication and coordination. People's courts, people's procuratorates, public security organs, and judicial administrative organs shall strengthen communication and coordination to ensure the smooth investigation, prosecution, trial, and execution of sentences in cases. For major, sensitive, and complex cases, public security organs shall promptly seek opinions and suggestions from the people's procuratorates. For major cases with significant social impact and high public attention, organizational leadership shall be strengthened; in accordance with the "three simultaneous" requirements of legal handling, public opinion guidance, and social control, the progress of the case shall be promptly reported to the public, the facts shall be clarified, and public opinion guidance shall be carried out.

(3) Protect litigation rights. All litigation rights of criminal suspects and defendants, especially the right to defense, shall be protected in accordance with law. In accordance with the requirement of full coverage of criminal defense lawyers, efforts shall be actively made to organize lawyers to provide defense or legal assistance for defendants who have not retained a defense lawyer. Judicial administrative organs at all levels shall strengthen guidance and supervision over lawyers' defense and representation work, guide lawyers to legally fulfill their defense and representation duties in accordance with laws and regulations, effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of criminal suspects and defendants, and ensure the correct implementation of the law.

(4) Strengthen publicity and education. People's courts, people's procuratorates, public security organs, and judicial administrative organs shall earnestly implement the responsibility system that "anyone who enforces the law shall popularize the law" and carry out in-depth legal publicity and education in conjunction with case handling. Typical cases shall be selected to explain the law, enhance warning education, deter criminals, and fully demonstrate the determination to severely punish such crimes and illegal acts in accordance with law and protect the life, health, and safety of the people. The general public shall be guided to abide by laws and regulations, not to believe or spread rumors, to legally support and cooperate with epidemic prevention and control work, and to create a good legal and social environment for the smooth progress of epidemic prevention and control work.

(5) Pay attention to case handling safety. During the epidemic prevention and control period, in handling cases involving the hindrance of the prevention and control of the COVID-19 epidemic, case handlers shall pay attention to their own safety, enhance awareness of prevention, and strengthen their ability to protect themselves and prevent risks when performing functions such as receiving and handling reports, arrests, custody, interrogation, trial, and execution. Except for situations where face-to-face contact is legally required, written review may be used as much as possible; when necessary, methods such as video may be used to interrogate criminal suspects, question victims and witnesses, and listen to defense lawyers' opinions. When people's courts hear relevant cases during the epidemic prevention and control period, while adhering to open trials in accordance with law, they shall minimize the gathering of people and effectively protect the safety and health of litigation participants, trial spectators, and court staff.
